text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, take this too!" "It's our famous 
kelp!" 
"Don't forget the dried salmon!" "Here's 
some smoked treats we made—"
choice_data_list: Thank you so much, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...The next time I see you, Trainer, 
will be at Tracen Academy... won't it?

Daring Tact's expression was stiff. She 
was likely tense thinking 
about the entrance exam. I wanted to give 
her one last push, but...
choice_data_list: (...Right, the final interview.)

text_block_list.text:
The entrance exam consisted of a written 
test, a practical exam, and an interview. 
We'd gone over the written and practical 
portions, but hadn't touched on the 
interview.
choice_data_list: Tact, about your final interview...

text_block_list.text:
—A gentle breeze swept past. The scent of 
nature flowing across Hokkaido's 
fertile earth... and the kind people who 
always watched over her.
choice_data_list:
...Just speak honestly about your feelings 
for your hometown.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Huh? 
...Um, is that... all?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. As long as you have that... you'll 
be fine.

Yeah. As long as you have that... you'll 
be fine.

text_block_list.text:
I could already picture it clearly. Daring 
Tact passing the exam, 
making her debut—and leaving behind a 
blazing trail of light.
choice_data_list:
—You're going to be a horsegirl who goes 
down in history.

—You're going to be a horsegirl who goes 
down in history.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much. 
I'm truly grateful... for everything 
you've done...!

After returning to Tokyo, I went quietly 
about my daily routine. At times, 
I could still feel the breeze from 
Hokkaido drifting through my heart... And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
It's already entrance exam season, huh. 
...I hope everyone can give it their all! 
All right, rookies get chore duty! Time to 
work!
choice_data_list: Yeah—
Yeah—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
choice_data_list: (...Do your best, Tact!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all very much for gathering for 
the 3rd session of the Tracen Academy 
Entrance Exam. 
I am Tazuna Hayakawa, secretary to the 
director. First—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, that girl over there... has a 
notebook from "Hillesta Academy." 
Man, so many girls from famous places have 
gathered again this year.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
I heard there's even a girl who doesn't 
belong to any development club at all. 
You see that once in a blue moon, but... 
she must be so anxious.
choice_data_list:
(She'll be fine. Tact... will be just 
fine.)

(She'll be fine. Tact... will be just 
fine!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(First is the written exam. I've reviewed 
the scope of the past ten years 
thoroughly. 
All that's left... is to relax my 
shoulders... Deep breath in, breath 
out...—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh, this question. Trainer made a 
mistake on this one... 
Hehe, I definitely have to get it right. 
...All right, keep this up!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Haahh...!!

text_block_list.name: Examinee Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa! That girl's physical ability is 
crazy...! What club is she from?" 
"Hmm... Usually I'd recognize faces from 
tournaments, but—"

text_block_list.name: Racing Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAH...!!

Hehe... Everyone is truly a wonderful 
horsegirl. 
Even so—

I'm the one who's gonna win! All of you, 
out of my way!! 
GRAAAAAAAAHHH!!

Haa... haa... Phew... 
—I'm sorry for startling you. Thank you 
for the race.

text_block_list.name: Examinee Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, isn't that girl—Win Marilyn?! 
Whoa, it's really her...! I watched the 
drama she starred in!

text_block_list.name: Examinee Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, her run was insane... and the 
others too. ...I guess 
just being a big deal back home... isn't 
enough to pass after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
("The way you are now, it'll be 
difficult"... I understand what Trainer 
meant back then. 
If I had stayed as I was, I would have 
gotten completely buried...)

text_block_list.name: Examiner
text_block_list.text:
Group D, please assemble near the gates! 
We will now begin the racing exam!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Have confidence, Tact. 
You're going to be fine, because you...—

A stir rippled through the trainers 
observing the test. 
Every pair of eyes was glued to a single, 
unknown horsegirl.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(I am strong. The earth of Hidaka and the 
mountains of Erimo have honed my body and 
mind. 
Everyone gave me all their love. And even 
now, blowing through—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The wind of my hometown pushes me 
forward!! 
—Haaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Wh-What an insane late kick...! 
That's incredible talent...! Which 
training club did she come from!?
choice_data_list: That girl is...

text_block_list.text:
She doesn't hail from any training club. 
Daring Tact loves her hometown, and was 
loved in return... 
Growing strong through the sheer power of 
harsh nature—
choice_data_list: —She's a horsegirl raised by Hidaka.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, for our final question. 
Daring Tact, what is your dream?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My dream is— 
To share the wonder of the hometown that 
raised me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...By becoming a horsegirl who goes down 
in history!
And so, time passed...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer. 
What do you think...?
choice_data_list:
Congratulations on your enrollment! It 
looks great on you.

Congratulations on your enrollment! It 
suits you so well.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. 
Thanks to you... I was able to see this 
day come.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
All that's left... is to make a smooth 
debut and deliver results.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. With you, I know you'll be just 
fine.

Mm-hm. You'll do wonderfully, I'm certain 
of it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............Alright. 
*inhale*... *exhale*.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
—Would you do me the honor of becoming my 
trainer?

Honestly, my heart raced. Ever since I 
first discovered her potential back in 
Hokkaido, 
I had been utterly captivated by her 
talent. Even so—
choice_data_list: ...It's still too early for you to decide.

text_block_list.text:
From here on, she could meet any number of 
brilliant trainers. 
Even if fate had brought us together, I 
was still a novice... Making a choice now 
would be premature.
choice_data_list:
It's an important partnership to fulfill 
your dreams, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...That's why it has to be you. 
It's with you—that I want to make my dream 
come true.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Because— 
You're the one who felt the very same wind 
as me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You recognized the strength my hometown 
nurtured within me... and tried to help it 
flourish. 
You truly understood the beauty of the 
home I love so dearly...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You looked at my dream. 
I cannot imagine having a better partner 
than you.
choice_data_list: Daring Tact...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please. Please... 
Help me become a horsegirl who makes 
history!
choice_data_list:
...Thank you. Let's make that dream come 
true together!

text_block_list.text:
A gentle breeze carrying the scent of 
spring blew past. 
Sweeping through from the northern 
lands—it heralded a brand-new beginning.
